children: Our Bureau Bengaluru: PB Fintech, the parent company of Policybazaar and Paisabazaar, reported a 43% year-on-year (YoY) increase in consolidated net profit to 192.39 crore in the September quarter, driven by strong growth in its core insurance marketplace business and higher renewal income, even as the company continued investing in newer businesses.

Net profit stood at 134.89 crore a year earlier. Sequentially, profit increased 18% from 162.91 crore in the June quarter. Revenue from operations grew 35% to 2,177.71 crore from 1,613.55 crore a year prior. On a sequential basis, revenue increased 15% from 1,888.28 crore. The growth was led by Policybazaar's insurance distribution business, where demand for health and term insurance remained strong.

Total insurance premiums rose 38% to 9,385 crore, with new protection premiums increasing 42%. New health insurance premiums grew 46% YoY. Revenue from its core online businesses, comprising Policybazaar and Paisabazaar, increased 39% to 1,336 crore. Within this, insurance revenue rose 42% to 1,211 crore, while credit revenue grew 19% to 125 crore.

Renewal and trail revenue, which represents recurring income from existing insurance and credit customers, increased 42% to 1,097 crore on a trailing 12-month basis. This has become an important contributor to profitability as the company's customer base expands. Paisabazaar's core loan disbursements rose 22% to 2,791 crore, marking the fifth consecutive quarter of sequential growth.

Meanwhile, revenue from newer initiatives grew 28% to 842 crore, led by its offline insurance distribution platform PB Partners and international operations. PB Partners' revenue rose 39% to 698 crore, while its active advisor network expanded 55% to 131,000.

However, adjusted Ebitda (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation) losses in newer businesses widened to 42 crore from 27 crore, reflecting investments including in PB Pay and Pensionbazaar. At the consolidated level, adjusted Ebitda increased 39% to 216 crore. Total expenses rose 33% to 2,067.66 crore, with advertising and promotional expenditure climbing 59%. title: PB Fintech Q2 Profit Rises 43% to 192cr
